segments.caption: HansiZappo Movie Teller
segments.text: Assalam o alaikum! HansiZappo Movie Teller mein khush aamdeed. Yeh hamari pehli video ka sample narration hai. Asal movie ki kahani aur research final hone ke baad is text ko replace kiya jayega.

segments.caption: Kahani shuru hoti hai
segments.text: Is jagah par movie ki kahani ka pehla hissa Roman Urdu mein likha jayega. Har hissa alag scene card aur voice-over ke saath video mein shamil hoga.

segments.caption: Yeh sirf test hai
segments.text: Yeh filhaal rendering system ko test karne ke liye sample hai. Isay final movie explanation na samjhein.
